couldNotCopyPleaseCheckBrowserClipboardP: Could not copy. Please check browser clipboard permissions.
chooseAnOperatorGetAStageByStageTrainer: Choose an operator. Get a stage-by-stage trainer schedule from your Box.

yourBoxHasNoOwnedE2OperatorsImportOr: Your Box has no owned E2 operators. Import or update your Box to continue.
enterTheCurrentMasteryOfTheSkillYouPlan: Enter the current mastery of the skill you plan to train. Start a new stage; no saved halving is assumed. The control bonus assumes a suitable operator remains stationed throughout.

computedLocallyNoBaseScheduleRequired: Computed locally. No base schedule required.

timesAreRelativeToTheStartFinishAndStart: Times are relative to the start. Finish and start each mastery stage manually at the indicated time.
